changes_required.description: Add PDF-specific LLM code generation constraints
required_constraints: FORBIDDEN: new FileSaveTarget(path) — use new FileDataSource(path) for output
FORBIDDEN: output_{0}.pdf or format strings in Splitter output — use plain 'output.pdf'
REQUIRED: using Aspose.Pdf; and using Aspose.Pdf.LowCode; always present
REQUIRED for TextExtractor: using Aspose.Pdf.Text; for TextFragment creation
REQUIRED: Create input PDF programmatically before LowCode API call
REQUIRED for TextExtractor: check result.ResultCollection[0] is StringResult sr; use sr.Text
system_prompt_additions: Aspose.PDF LowCode uses instance-method pattern: new Plugin().Process(options)
TextExtractor: no AddOutput(), result in ResultCollection[0] as StringResult.Text

new_validation_rules: If family=pdf: reject code containing 'new FileSaveTarget(' — wrong output type
If family=pdf: reject code containing '.IsSuccess' — wrong result check
If family=pdf: reject code containing '.OperationResult' — wrong collection name
If family=pdf: reject code using static method call pattern (XxxType.Method) — must be instance
If family=pdf and type=TextExtractor: reject code with AddOutput() call

does not contain a definition for 'OperationResult'
